ABOUT US

A garden restaurant built for family moments

Kesar Dhaba Family Garden Restaurant in Ekodi is a warm, family-friendly retreat where good food and open-air comfort come together. Our garden setting, string lights and relaxed seating are designed for evenings that stretch a little longer — with the people who matter most.

Whether you're stopping by for a casual meal with the family, gathering friends for an evening out, or looking for a space to celebrate something special, Kesar Dhaba offers a relaxing atmosphere both indoors and under the open sky.
